steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?
Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates said Brisbane Broncos’ financials looked steady like Manchester United’s, with revenue barely changing year to year at about $38 million, highlighting how club revenues often showed limited growth.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In September 2023, Equity Mates noted Brisbane Broncos, listed as ASX BBL, had almost doubled its share price over five years, using it as an example of a listed sports team that delivered solid share price gains.

episode.title: Ren talks Resmed + GQG Partners, UFC and WWE are merging, & trying to perfect DCA investing

views.text: In June 2023, Equity Mates reported News Corp owned about 70 percent of Brisbane Broncos and said the club’s share market performance had not been a standout, though it had been acceptable.

episode.title: News Corp (NWS) deep dive w/ Will Granger | Airlie Funds
